assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and key area boundaries are provisional rough polygons derived from public announcement text, not official CAD/GIS boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics (site area, land use area, FAR, density, ratios) are provisional and must be recalculated when official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Official floor area ratio (FAR) controls are missing from the public site package; the submitted FAR is a concept-level design estimate.
assumptions.impact: The submitted FAR value should not be used for statutory planning approval; it reflects design intent only.

assumptions.statement: Official building height controls are missing; building heights are assigned based on land use type and concept design intent.
assumptions.impact: Height assignments are design proposals, not regulatory compliance with aviation, landscape, or heritage height controls.

assumptions.statement: Official building density controls are missing; building density is computed from generated concept building footprints.
assumptions.impact: The density value reflects the concept design layout, not approved regulatory density limits.

assumptions.statement: Official green ratio controls are missing; green space area includes heritage park belt, community parks, and street green spaces as designed.
assumptions.impact: The green ratio is a design proposal; official green ratio standards must be confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Road areas are estimated as centerline length multiplied by assumed pavement width per road class; road redlines are not available.
assumptions.impact: Road area and ratio are approximate; official road redline data is needed for precise calculation.

assumptions.statement: The Jingzhang railway heritage protection zone and railway relic line are inferred from public historical materials; the official cultural heritage protection boundary has not been provided.
assumptions.impact: Heritage constraint polygons are provisional; official文保范围 must be obtained before statutory use.

assumptions.statement: The blue line (小月河蓝线) is inferred from public topographic data; the official water authority blue line has not been provided.
assumptions.impact: Blue line constraint is provisional; official蓝线 must be obtained from the water authority.

assumptions.statement: Phasing boundaries divide the site into three temporal stages (near/mid/long term) based on key area priorities; no official phasing plan is available.
assumptions.impact: Phasing is a design proposal reflecting implementation strategy, not an official implementation schedule.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, types, heights, and floor counts are concept-level design proposals generated to demonstrate spatial design intent, not engineering or architectural designs.
assumptions.impact: Building data should be treated as massing studies; detailed architectural design is required for further development.
